scope: Exact-y placement for topAndBottom floats between/inside blocks, with following flow adjusted

implementation.boundary: blockFloatPlan inserts the float before the first item whose flow extent contains y (y < flowTop + height); no anchor-index clamp and no midpoint rounding
implementation.exactY: Top offset is rendered as an explicit spacer div (height = y - flowTop) followed by the float block with margin 0, so CSS margin collapsing cannot shift the float
implementation.flow: The float block participates in flow, so the paragraph at the insertion point starts after the float bottom; content above y keeps its position
implementation.betweenBlocks: A float whose y falls between paragraphs lands exactly at y and the following paragraph is pushed below the float bottom

realDoc.note: Page count varies 145-147 between loads because heights are measured asynchronously; the real document has no floating objects, so exact-y placement is not involved

remaining: VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
